title: Eleven Words at the Centre
subtitle: 核心与要点 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 核心与要点（语言与思维·核心与要点）
meta: 主题语境：核心与要点（语言与思维·核心与要点）　|　核心词汇：core　|　正文 334 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 core 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 my teacher ① wrote the core of the argument in eleven words, and she said the writing was the whole of the thinking. The ② core, meaning the centre and not the rest, fit on one line and stayed there; core, she said, is the only thing in an argument that is judged by how much can be taken away.

Every ③ core in that subject had the same example, and the ④ core at the end, meaning the one she kept for the exam and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever learned twice. Core, my mother said, is nine parts taking away and one part somebody willing to stop; my teacher said the stopping is the part that fills one line.

My grandfather meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the core was the whole of the apple, meaning the pips and not the centre. The ⑥ core, meaning the pips and not any of that, is the only thing in an apple that everybody throws away and nobody plants; core, he said, is either something you write or the only word that means both a centre and a set of pips. She said the pips are the part they remember.

By 1971 the ⑦ core had become a line in a syllabus, and the syllabus had become an argument about the example. The ⑧ core of the whole thing, my teacher wrote in February, was one line and thirty years of taking away; core, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stop. He said the stopping was never mentioned.

The ⑨ core I remember is the one at the end, which she wrote in 1977 and is still described as the shortest in the school. A ⑩ core, my mother said in 1979, is the only thing that improves by being learned; every core, she said, is a set of pips that has agreed to look like a centre. She said the pips were the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 核心（指那个中心本身，与其余部分相对）
C. 固定搭配：the core of the argument 论证的核心
D. n. 核心（指那门课里每一个）
E. n. 核心（指末尾那一个）
F. n. 果核；果心（指苹果的核）
G. n. 核心（指教学大纲里提到的那一项）
H. n. 中心部分；要义（抽象总称）

items.q: wrote the core of the argument in eleven words
The core, meaning the centre and not the rest
the core was the whole of the apple
the core had become a line in a syllabus
The core of the whole thing
A core, my mother said in 1979

answers.why: the core of the argument 意为“论证的核心”，1963 年老师用十一个词写下了论证的核心。
core 意为“核心”，指那个中心本身而不是其余部分，一行就写得下。
core 指那门课里每一个核心要点，每一个都用同一个例子。
core 指末尾那一个（她留给考试的那一个），是唯一有人学过两次的。
core 意为“果核、果心”，祖父说果核就是那个苹果的全部，指的是那几粒籽而不是那个中心。
core 为具体义，指苹果的核而不是那个中心，是苹果里人人都扔掉、却无人种下的东西。
core 意为“核心”，指教学大纲里提到的那一项，到 1971 年这个核心成了大纲里的一行。
core 意为“中心部分、要义”，老师二月写道，整件事的要义是一行字三十年的删减。
core 意为“核心、要点”，我记得的是末尾那一个，她 1977 年写的，至今仍被说成全校最短的。
core 为抽象总称，母亲说一个核心是唯一会因为被记住而变好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年老师用十一个词写下了论证的核心，她说写下才是这整个思考的全部。（the core of the argument）
那个核心，指的是那个中心本身而不是其余部分，一行就写得下，并且一直写在那儿。（core）
那门课里每一个核心要点都用同一个例子。（core）
末尾那一个核心，指的是她留给考试的那一个，是唯一有人学过两次的。（core）
祖父说果核就是那个苹果的全部，指的是那几粒籽而不是那个中心。（core）
1979 年母亲说，一个核心是唯一会因为被记住而变好的东西。（core）
answers: In 1963 my teacher wrote the core of the argument in eleven words, and she said the writing was the whole of the thinking.
The core, meaning the centre and not the rest, fit on one line and stayed there.
Every core in that subject had the same example.
The core at the end, meaning the one she kept for the exam and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever learned twice.
My grandfather said the core was the whole of the apple, meaning the pips and not the centre.
A core, my mother said in 1979, is the only thing that improves by being learned.
